newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares down, but traders upbeat.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares down, but traders upbeat.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 1.21 percent on Tuesady as correction after steep gains over past three weeks continues, but market participants said shares may resume upward trend later in the week.
"Mostly domestic investors were selling today, trying to realise their short-term profits," said Robert Rudolf, a trader at brokerage Moja delnica.
* The SBI index fell 15.33 points to 1,254.60.
* Turnover fell to 464.3 million tolars from 591.6 million.
* Bank SKB was the most actively traded, firming 1.41 percent to 41,580 tolars.
